paper.title_en: Higher-order chiral Lagrangians with vector meson nonet in different representations
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, chiral Lagrangians with vector meson nonet are constructed across multiple representations, including those to the next-to-leading order in the vector-field representation, as well as to the next-to-next-to-leading order in the tensor-field and hidden local symmetry representations. For the next-to-leading order octet, redundant terms in the other literature are also identified in both the tensor-field and hidden local symmetry representations. Additionally, the equivalence between the tensor-field and hidden local symmetry representations is examined.
